_comment: pinned 决定展示顺序与置顶；curated 覆盖描述/标签（留空则用 GitHub 上的）；discover=true 时新仓库自动追加；exclude 为黑名单。

search2chart-mcp.description: Agent-native charting — turn search, research, and tabular data into inline charts in agent conversations. Native DSH plugin for true inline rendering + cross-agent MCP server with file-link and interactive mode.

429-throttle-mcp.description: Rate-limited MCP proxy with agent operator skill — eliminate HTTP 429 errors on free LLM APIs. Automatic speed control, conversational parameter tuning, and long-task retrospectives built in.

inspidea.description: Minimal cross-platform inspiration capture tool. One hotkey to summon, Enter to save. Pure Markdown local-first storage with Notion, Dropbox, and WebDAV sync. Built with Tauri 2 + React.
